_comment: Fire-drill scenarios for the outage-watch dashboard. Copy this file, edit the checklist text for your organisation, and start with --drills yourfile.json. Drills run only in the browser's SIMULATION layer: no probe, freeze file, hook, webhook or log is touched. 't' is seconds after the drill starts. effect: slow (adds add_ms latency), fail (probe does not answer), heal.

common_checklist.title: Acknowledge: name an incident lead
common_checklist.detail: One person owns the incident and the clock from now on.

common_checklist.title: Rule out our own network
common_checklist.detail: Read the verdict line. If everything fails, or services show 'blocked', check our own DNS, proxy and firewall first.

common_checklist.title: Switch to the out-of-band channel
common_checklist.detail: Use the pre-agreed channel that does not depend on Microsoft 365 (for example an SMS group or a non-M365 chat). The contact list must live outside M365.

common_checklist.title: Tell staff what still works
common_checklist.detail: Use 'Copy staff update' in the dashboard. State what our checks saw and when; do not guess a cause.

common_checklist.title: Freeze risky changes
common_checklist.detail: No tenant, Conditional Access or licensing changes and no deployments while the level is 'freeze'.

common_checklist.title: Save the timeline
common_checklist.detail: Keep outagewatch.jsonl and note its head hash (python3 report.py LOG --verify) somewhere outside this host.

drills.title: Shared sign-in configuration failure
drills.pattern: Pattern type: shared authentication dependency (as reported for the 31 Aug 2026 outage; attribution preliminary).
drills.description: Sign-in slows, then stops answering. Every service that needs sign-in is at risk even though its own probe still answers.

checklist.title: Check the break-glass admin accounts
checklist.detail: Confirm where the offline credentials for the two cloud-only break-glass accounts are. Do not use them unless needed.

checklist.title: Remind staff: stay signed in
checklist.detail: Sessions that are already open may keep working. Outlook in cached mode can still read and draft offline.

drills.title: Maintenance-deployment slowdown on one service
drills.pattern: Pattern type: maintenance deployment degrading one service (as reported for June 2026; attribution preliminary).
drills.description: Exchange gets slower and slower without failing outright. This is the early-warning case: the level should reach 'caution' before anything is down.

checklist.title: Decide at 'caution': who watches, and for how long?
checklist.detail: Nothing is down yet. Agree the trigger for escalating.

drills.title: Network-infrastructure partial outage
drills.pattern: Pattern type: supporting network infrastructure / third-party network provider (as reported for Jan and Mar 2026; attribution preliminary).
drills.description: Several unrelated services fail at once while sign-in keeps answering. The first question is whether it is our network or theirs.

checklist.title: Compare from a second network
checklist.detail: Run 'python3 outagewatch.py --test' from another site or a phone hotspot before telling anyone the provider is down.

drills.title: Copilot-only failure
drills.pattern: Pattern type: one product layer failing while the services under it stay healthy.
drills.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot and its data layer stop answering; mail, files and meetings are unaffected.

checklist.title: Decide whether this needs a freeze at all
checklist.detail: The level goes to 'freeze' on any confirmed failure. Agree whether a Copilot-only failure should pause your deployments.
